theta_source: REUSED L5 NUTS draws from netcg out/theta_post_L5.npz (no sampler run in this card)

diagnostic_C5.purpose: locate the C5 non-reproduction (pre-registered in decisions_log D3 BEFORE this ran)

suspect_1_width_convention.study_netcg_wide.band_width_ratio: grms(smooth(hi))/grms(smooth(lo))  [upper/lower ENVELOPE ratio; never references FEM+6dB]
suspect_1_width_convention.note: BOTH computed here from the SAME lo/hi arrays of the SAME delivered statfem_Fk band. They are different quantities, so they cannot agree at any calibration.

suspect_2_statfem_marginal.netcg: marg = 0.25 + (SD_A_U-0.25)*ufrac ; ufrac = UNMEASURED-mode energy fraction (netcg_qoi.py Method.ensemble/statfem_fk)
suspect_2_statfem_marginal.study: marg = max(0.25, wfrac) ; wfrac = contribution-weighted MEAN SD_A over ALL modes (netcg_wide.py:143-147)
suspect_2_statfem_marginal.note: different functional form -> different width even under the same width convention.

suspect_3_theta_ensemble.netcg: 60 theta draws x n_disc=40 = 2400 spectra (theta uncertainty INSIDE the band)
suspect_3_theta_ensemble.study: single theta (theta_MAP_wide) x 400 draws (theta uncertainty ABSENT from the band)
suspect_3_theta_ensemble.note: study bands carry no theta spread; see N1 for the theta-point contribution.
